t_advice_summary_textbox.text: the goal is to reach the forest which contains the most mushrooms. the forest (dark or light) will constantly change but the colour gnome which leads there is always consitent. the goal is to determine which foreset is corrently providing the most mushrooms

vb_textbox.text: the gnomes appear in fixed pairs: orange and brown, green and pink, red and yellow, blue and purple. no other variations in positions or hats matter, just the colour. each known within the pair leads to a different forest, one leading to the light forest and one to the dark forest. The orange, green, red, and blue gnomes lead to the bright forest while the brown, pink, yellow, and purple gnomes lead to the dark forest. the goal is to reach the forest that currently has the most mushrooms. The number of mushrooms in each forest constantly changes,  but the information previously provided can be used to reach the forest and keep track of the number of mushrooms you can harvet there. Try to go to the forest containing the most mushrooms. The success lies with recognising which colour gnome leads to which forest. In my study I found that more often then not, the dark forest contained the most mushrooms, and so I used the method of repeating the words 'brown, pink, yellow, purple' in my head so I could quickly go to the dark forest. If I found the light forest was now containing the most, I could repeat the same phase, but instead chose the opposing gnome of the pair I had said out loud. My personal method may not work for you, but maintain focus and get a lot of mushrooms. Good luck!
